exclusions.source_text: Creatinine ≤ institutional upper limit of normal OR
exclusions.threshold: creatinine ≤ institutional ULN unless CrCl ≥ 60 mL/min/1.73 m2

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin within normal institutional limits (except for participant's with Gilbert's disease)
AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤ 2.5 × institutional upper limit of normal
Tumors primarily localized in the infratentorial compartment will be excluded.

History of a different malignancy, unless (a) have been disease-free for at least 2 years and are deemed by the investigator to be at low risk for recurrence of that malignancy, and/or (b) malignancy was cervical cancer in situ, superficial bladder cancer or basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, and malignancy has been treated.
exclusions.threshold: disease-free for at least 2 years unless exceptions

exclusions.source_text: Active uncontrolled cardiac disease, including cardiomyopathy, congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association functional classification of ≥2), unstable angina, myocardial infarction within 12 months of enrollment, or ventricular arrhythmia.
--QTc interval \> 450 ms for men or \> 470 ms for women.
Persistent or history of clinically meaningful ventricular arrhythmias or atrial fibrillation.
Unstable pectoris or myocardial infarction ≤ 3 months prior to starting study treatment.
Uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, or subjects with either of the following:
Known active Hepatitis B (e.g., HBsAg reactive) or Hepatitis C (e.g., HCV RNS \[qualitative\] is detected).
Current use of warfarin sodium or any other coumadin-derivative anticoagulant.
